notes: The client joins the Bright Life program and is covered by its Health Shield Plan. Bright Life’s own underwriting decides — nothing is guaranteed until they accept the client.

Precertification is required for hospital admissions, imaging (CT/PET/MRI/MRA), home health, skilled nursing, hospice, DME over $750 ($500 on VL 1500), chemo/radiation, sleep studies, prosthetics/orthotics, therapies (chiropractic, cardiac, PT/OT/ST) and outpatient surgery. Missing it can cut the allowed charge by 50% or deny the claim. After an emergency admission, Marpai must be told within 48 hours or by the next business day.
Copays still apply after the deductible is met.
A true emergency can go to the nearest ER with no out-of-network penalty.

Not covered on PPO 1250: acupuncture, biofeedback, bariatric surgery, cosmetic surgery, adult dental, children’s dental check-ups, children’s glasses, children’s eye exams (unless preventive), routine adult eye care, hearing aids, infertility, long-term care, private-duty nursing, routine foot care, weight-loss programs, non-emergency care outside the U.S.
PPO 1250: in-network and out-of-network deductibles and out-of-pocket limits are separate and don’t cross over. Coverage period 9/1/2026 – 12/31/2027; rates effective 1 November 2026.

Not covered on VL 1500: organ transplant, dialysis, out-of-network care (except emergencies), adult dental, hearing aids, infertility, long-term care, cosmetic surgery, bariatric surgery, routine foot care, weight-loss programs, care outside the U.S.

Humana dental: “TRP” is Humana’s Traditional Preferred network, sold in AK, GA, LA, SD, TX and WV instead of the PPO plans. The dental summaries on file are Humana’s Florida filings — confirm state details with Humana.
Bright Life marketing must approve anything client-facing. This panel is for the agent.
